name: qwen
competence: Cost-sensitive coding work on open-weight Qwen models, including self-hosted endpoints
weaknesses: weaker on long-horizon agentic work than frontier models

plan.prompt_prefix: Before writing any code, work out the structure: which files to create, what each is responsible for, and the interfaces between them. State that plan, then implement it. Task:

parallel.prompt_prefix: This change spans many files. Work through them in independent batches rather than one long serial pass, and keep a checklist of what is done. Task:

readonly.prompt_prefix: Do not modify, create, or delete any file. Read, analyse, and report your findings only. Task:
readonly.note: advisory only -- no read-only flag confirmed

no_op.prompt_prefix: Your previous run described this work instead of doing it. Do not restate the plan -- make the edits on disk now, and finish by listing the files you changed. Task:
no_op.note: re-dispatch with an explicit apply-the-edits instruction; qwen declares no unattended mode to force, so this is prompt-level only

stuck.prompt_prefix: You are running headless: nobody can answer a question, and asking one ends the run with nothing done. Make reasonable assumptions, complete the task, and record those assumptions in your final message. Task:
stuck.note: re-dispatch telling the agent no answer can arrive

failed.prompt_prefix: A previous attempt at this task errored out. Inspect the working tree for half-applied changes, clean them up, then complete the task. Task:
failed.note: re-dispatch after checking the tree for partial work
